name: spellkave_intervention_windows
label: Spellkave Intervention Windows
description: List the connected actor's OPEN post-roll intervention windows — a time-boxed pause after one of the actor's own stochastic actions, before the outcome commits. `faces` are the already-drawn, already-visible die face(s) for that action (two faces when the roll had Advantage/Disadvantage, otherwise one). The window closes on its own (equivalent to declining) if not answered before window_closes_at_micros. Respond with spellkave_react_option using this listing's handle: omit selected_draw_index to decline (the original result stands, nothing is spent), or pass the index of one listed face to accept (spends this window's fuel resource and replaces exactly that face — the new roll must then be used).
